title: Ariadne extractor output
description: What the extractor LLM must return for one ingested turn (or batch). A JSON-Patch against the current state document plus typed memories to index. This is the model's ENTIRE output: no prose, no code fences. The worker validates against this schema first, then applies `state_patch` and re-validates the result against state-doc.schema.json. A response failing this schema is retried once with a stricter prompt, then the turn is skipped for T1 (T0/T3 are unaffected).

state_patch.description: RFC 6902 operations against the current state document. Empty when the turn changes nothing durable — this is the common, correct case for chit-chat. NEVER target /pins, /meta, or /schema.

path.description: Allowed roots only. The pattern is a guard; code re-checks.

memories.description: Atomic, self-contained memories to index in T3. Each must read correctly with zero surrounding context. Prefer memories over large state edits.

supersedes_hint.description: If this contradicts an earlier memory, paraphrase the old claim here so the worker can find and tombstone it. Optional.

segment_boundary.description: True if this turn starts a clearly new topic/phase, hinting the summarizer to close the current segment.

notes_for_reviewer.description: Optional. Only for flagging something the extractor is unsure about (e.g. a possible scope change). Not stored in state.
